summary: Mutual NDA on Ballymote's paper with an uncapped indemnity, a 24-month broad non-solicit, a resist-at-own-cost compelled disclosure clause and narrow Representatives, otherwise broadly aligned.

findings.quote: the Recipient hereby covenants, undertakes, and agrees with the Discloser that it shall:
findings.why: Obligations bind the Recipient and Discloser is defined so either Party can be either.

findings.quote: disclosed, imparted, or communicated by or on behalf of the Discloser to the Recipient in connection with the Permitted Purpose
findings.why: Definition covers information disclosed for the Purpose, is not marking-dependent, and includes derived notes and analyses.

findings.quote: solely and exclusively for the advancement and execution of the Permitted Purpose
findings.why: Use is limited to the Permitted Purpose, a potential commercial reseller/partnering relationship.

findings.quote: by persons who had no access to, knowledge of, or reference to any part of the Discloser's Confidential Information
findings.why: Independent development is narrowed to persons with no access to the Discloser's information, which is stricter than the plain independent-development carve-out.
findings.draft_redline: 4.1.4 has been independently developed by or for the Recipient without use of or reference to the Discloser's Confidential Information.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would suggest the independent development exception refer to development without use of the Discloser's information, rather than by persons with no knowledge of it. This keeps the exception workable for both of us.

findings.quote: its lawful directors, statutory officers, employees, legal advisors, statutory auditors, and designated financial counselors
findings.why: Representatives do not include Affiliates/Group members or insurers and there is no consent mechanism to disclose to Group members.
findings.draft_redline: "Representatives" means, in relation to a Party, its and its Group members' directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, auditors and insurers who need to know Confidential Information for the Permitted Purpose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please could we extend Representatives to cover Group members and insurers on a need-to-know basis? The Recipient would remain responsible for them under clause 3.3.

findings.quote: the Recipient shall, to the extent permitted by Applicable Law:
findings.why: Notice is given only where permitted by law and cooperation is at the Discloser's cost.

findings.quote: the Recipient has first, at the Recipient's sole expense and cost, instituted, pursued, and exhausted all available legal motions, appeals, and formal proceedings to quash, challenge, and resist such disclosure order
findings.why: Recipient must resist and challenge compelled disclosure at its own cost and is strictly liable, contrary to the Disclosing Party bearing the cost.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 5.3; the Recipient shall disclose only to the extent required by law and, where lawful, shall at the Discloser's cost use reasonable endeavours to obtain confidential treatment.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We cannot agree to resist every compelled disclosure at our own cost with strict liability. We propose that any challenge is made at the Discloser's cost, as in clause 5.1.2.

findings.quote: the Recipient shall disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information which it is advised by reputable written legal opinion it is strictly compelled and legally obligated to furnish
findings.why: Requires a written legal opinion before any compelled disclosure, an extra condition the playbook does not cover.
findings.draft_redline: the Recipient shall disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information which it is legally required to disclose.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please could we remove the requirement for a written legal opinion, so that disclosure is limited to what is legally required?

findings.quote: within fourteen (14) calendar days of receipt of such instruction:
findings.why: Return period is over 5 Business Days, with officer certificate and a backup/legal retention exception in 6.2.

findings.quote: All right, title, interest, and intellectual property rights in and to the Confidential Information shall remain vested exclusively in the Discloser or its lawful licensors.
findings.why: IP stays with the Discloser and no licence beyond review for the Permitted Purpose is granted in 10.2.

findings.quote: the Discloser makes no covenant, condition, representation, or warranty, whether express, statutory, or implied, regarding the accuracy, completeness
findings.why: Mutual as-is disclaimer with no Halyard warranty; no fraud exclusion or proceed sentence appears.
findings.fallback_cited: Mutual disclaimers in any reasonable wording.

findings.quote: not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, translate, decipher, probe
findings.why: Reverse engineering of software and prototypes is prohibited.

findings.quote: The Recipient shall defend, hold harmless, and indemnify the Discloser, its Affiliates
findings.why: Contains an uncapped indemnity for any breach, while the playbook prefers no indemnity.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We do not give indemnities in our NDAs; liability for breach is left to the general law, which protects both Parties. We propose deleting clause 7.

findings.quote: for a period of twenty-four (24) months following the date of termination or expiration of this Agreement
findings.why: Non-solicit runs over 12 months post-term.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 8, or limit it to 12 months, staff the Party worked with in the discussions, with an exception for general advertising.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We do not usually include a non-solicitation clause. If one is required, we could agree a mutual restriction of 12 months, limited to staff involved in the discussions, with a general-advertising exception.

findings.quote: employee, officer, or contractor of the other Party or any of its Affiliates
findings.why: Covers all employees, officers, contractors and Affiliate staff, with no general-advertising exception and a hiring ban.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 8, or limit it as above.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please could the restriction be limited to staff involved in the discussions and exclude responses to general advertising?

findings.quote: a primary term of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party upon serving thirty (30) calendar days' written notice
findings.why: Term of 2 years with 30 days' notice matches the preferred position.

findings.quote: for a period of five (5) years following the date of expiration or termination
findings.why: Survival of 5 years is within 2 to 5 years, with indefinite protection limited to trade secrets.

findings.quote: the Discloser shall be entitled, without the necessity of proving actual damages or posting any bond, surety, or other security, to seek and obtain
findings.why: Equitable relief is available to either Party as Discloser; no bond; remedies cumulative.
findings.fallback_cited: Strongly worded but mutual equitable relief.

findings.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales
findings.why: English law and exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

findings.quote: Neither Party shall assign, transfer, sub-contract, charge, encumber, or otherwise dispose of this Agreement
findings.why: No assignment by either Party without prior written consent.

findings.quote: within two (2) Business Days, notify the Discloser in writing upon discovering
findings.why: Breach-notification and mitigation-at-own-cost obligation is not covered by the playbook; Business Days is also undefined.
findings.draft_redline: The Recipient shall promptly notify the Discloser in writing on becoming aware of any unauthorised disclosure of Confidential Information and shall give reasonable assistance.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please could we make the notification period 'promptly' and ensure Business Day is defined if a fixed period is kept?

findings.quote: personnel data, financial models
findings.why: Confidential Information expressly includes personnel and customer data but there are no data protection terms or DPA commitment.
findings.draft_redline: Neither Party shall disclose personal data under this Agreement, other than business contact details, unless the Parties have first entered into a data sharing or processing agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: As personnel and customer data may be caught by the definition, we propose that no personal data is shared beyond business contact details without a separate data agreement.
